name: Hua Tuo Medical & Biomedical Academy
basedOn: MacGyver Engineering Academy v11 architecture (static-first academy, Python stdlib server, step-based curriculum, personalization, voice, commerce)

backend.accounts: username + password + e-mail + mobile; e-mail and SMS one-time codes (SMTP, Twilio, Mitake or webhook); dev mode on loopback
backend.billing: first section free; pass-30 NT$299, pass-365 NT$2490; Stripe Checkout (3DS), ECPay AioCheckOut, post-office transfer claims; payout account 700 / 0101034 / 0187821 registered at the gateway
backend.ai: llama.cpp / Ollama / OpenAI-compatible / OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini routes with curriculum + local document retrieval

voiceLanguagePolicy: Interface and narration follow the viewer's browser language preference (navigator.languages), never GPS/IP; both can be pinned manually. Currency follows the language region subtag or time zone and can be changed.
iconPolicy: Original offline monoline SVG icon system; every topic has a unique descriptor verified at build time; no third-party icon sets.
scope: Medical education only; not clinical protocols; supervised training and licensure required.
